text: Meet Alex. Every night, Alex sits down and turns ideas into words. Hours of research. Countless drafts. Stories that could genuinely help thousands of people.
Then comes the big moment. Alex hits publish. People read it. They share it with friends. Thousands of readers discover the work.
But there's one problem. Despite creating something valuable, Alex can barely earn from it.
On one platform, income depends on ads and clicks. On another, an algorithm decides who gets seen. Some take a cut of every earning. Others make it hard to reach your own readers.
The reader gets knowledge. The platform gets revenue. And the creator? Left with the smallest slice of the pie.
And Alex isn't alone. Millions of independent writers face the same problem. Publishing became easy. Earning never did.

So imagine a different world. What if readers could reward writers directly? No ads. No algorithms. No middlemen. And what if writers could do more than earn? What if they could grow their earnings on the blockchain?
This is NimInk. Write. Earn. Stake. A writing and earning app, built right inside Nimiq Pay. No ads. No separate accounts. Just a wallet, an idea, and a community that values good writing.
Readers discover articles through Latest, Popular and Top Tipped. They read, test their knowledge with quick quizzes, and find creators worth following.
And when something is truly valuable, they can do more than tap a like button. They tip the writer directly, in NIM. A simple gesture becomes real support.
Now Alex can publish free articles, sell premium content, and build subscriptions. All paid straight to Alex's wallet.
Readers can even post a paid request. Set a budget. Set a deadline. Writers submit their work, and the requester picks the winner and pays them. Demand meets knowledge.
Months later, Alex has an audience, and a growing balance. The earnings dashboard shows every transaction, and exactly where the income came from. Tips. Subscriptions. Article sales. And requests.

And now, the part that changes everything. Instead of leaving those earnings idle, Alex taps Stake NIM. Choose a validator. Check the fee, and the trust score. Enter an amount. Review. Confirm. All inside the app. Alex's earnings are now put to work, with a chance to earn staking rewards. Rewards vary, and are never guaranteed.
From writing, to earning, to staking. One ecosystem. One wallet. More possibilities.
And because a creator economy needs trust, NimInk has content reporting, moderation, fraud protection and reputation built in. So quality writing, and genuine support, always matter.

Thousands of writers. Thousands of readers. Value flowing directly to the people who create it. Because writing deserves more than views. It deserves recognition. Rewards. And opportunity. NimInk. Write. Earn. Stake.
